meta.name: lark-event
meta.description: Lark/Feishu real-time event listening / subscribing / consuming: stream events as NDJSON via `lark-cli event consume <EventKey>` (covers IM messages/reactions/chat changes, Approval status changes, Task updates, VC meeting started/joined/ended, Minutes generated, Whiteboard updated, etc.). Use for Lark bots, real-time message processing, long-running subscribers, streaming webhook/push handlers. Supports `--max-events` / `--timeout` bounded runs and a stderr ready-marker contract — designed for AI agents running as subprocesses.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以实时监听飞书/ Lark 的事件（如新消息、审批状态变化、会议开始等），并将事件以 NDJSON 格式输出到终端。
howto.when: 当用户要求 Claude 监听某个飞书事件（如新消息、会议状态变化等），并运行 `lark-cli event consume` 命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我监听飞书新消息事件，持续运行。
say.note: Claude 会启动一个持续监听进程，输出新消息事件。

say.text: 监听一次会议开始事件，超时30秒。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can listen to Lark/Feishu real-time events (e.g., new messages, approval status changes, meeting started) and output them as NDJSON to stdout.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks Claude to listen to a specific Lark event (e.g., new message, meeting status change) and runs the `lark-cli event consume` command.

say_en.text: Listen to Lark new message events and keep running.
say_en.note: Claude starts a long-running process that outputs new message events.

say_en.text: Listen for one meeting started event with a 30-second timeout.
say_en.note: Claude runs a bounded listener that exits after receiving one event.
